notes: Seven countywide elected offices share the Kaufman County boundary: County Judge Jakie Allen; Sheriff Bryan Beavers; County Clerk Laura Hughes; District Clerk Rhonda Hughey; Tax Assessor-Collector Teressa Floyd; County Treasurer Charles “Chuck” Mohnkern; and Criminal District Attorney Erleigh Norville Wiley. Government Code § 44.229 assigns the single Criminal District Attorney office both county-attorney and district-attorney duties, so no duplicate prosecutor office is created. Census GEOID 48257.
